notes.title: UPDATE 1768
notes.content:
Changes for Update 1768

[list]
[*] New Weapon added Flame Thrower
[*] New Weapon added Oil
[*] New Weapon added Smokescreen
[*] New Death Messages - Player willl know who killed him and how 
[*] New Kill Messages - Added information on who killed who
[*] New Powerup Ghost - Player is like a ghost for 10 seconds
[*] New Powerup Quad Damage - Weapons do 4 times more damage
[*] New Powerup Nito - Get full nitro on pickup
[*] Game ends at correct time after all players have reached the goal
[*] Players can now paint the car in the color they want
[*] All addons and updates to the cars now change the behaviour of the car as expected with additional, weight, armor, engine improvments and so on.
[/list]

As always, enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 1699 RELEASED!
notes.content:
UPDATE 1699 CONTAINS THE FOLLOWING:

[list]
[*] Change between drift and non drift mode in Settings
[*] Updated Infernoz Arena with lava rivers
[*] Updated with a new network smooth syncing system for a silky smooth network experience
[*] AI racing and aggresiveness is improved by about 5-10%
[*] Camera sensitivity can be set
[*] Steering Sensitivity can be set
[*] Wheels return to original position whenever you change direction or release button
[*] Less time for camera to return to follow car position
[*] Improved steering control
[*] Race mode has less drift and drift help then Drift mode
[*] Drift settings are synced over the network
[*] AI Bots now randomise between drift and race mode
[*] Improved graphical quality on Meadowz
[*] Race now ends after 60 seconds has passed or all players have finished or are wrecked.
[/list]

Enjoy!


,, , , , , ,.

notes.title: UPCOMING NEW CONTROL SCHEME
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

since many people have issues regarding the current drifting system we are going to add a whole new control scheme for people who enjoy a more regular car handling. 

We think the drifting system is a fun and different way of handling the car and takes some time to get used to but we also want to appeal to fans who are used to a more regular type of control. So we decided to have both in the game from now on.

We hope to get this new control scheme in the next update by tomorrow. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE BUILD 1671
notes.content:
This hotfix contains the following things:

[list]
[*] Improved Traction Control System
[*] Removed faulty/invisible colliders
[*] Improved AI racing ability and aggresiveness
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: GAMES IS OUT ON STEAM!
notes.content: Game is now out on steam and fully playable over LAN, Single Player or Online with up to 50 players or AI! Let the race begin!

notes.title: ZAACAR POSTPONED UNTIL MAY 19TH
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we sadly have to inform you guys that the game is once again postponed due to a networking isssue that was recently discovered. It was a hard decision but it had to be made as we want you guys to have a great experience when playing Zaacar online. On a sidenote, the additional time gives us the opportunity to add even more maps and content.

Looking forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

notes.title: GAME POSTPONED UNTIL MAY 4TH 2021
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

we made a decision to postpone the release of Zaacar to be able to polish certain sections of the game an extra round. We are sorry for the delay but we promise it will be worth the wait! 

Join us now on our Discord channel for the latest news and updates!

https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/89K6S8rRJm

notes.title: OPEN AND CLOSED BETA SUCCESFULLY COMPLETED
notes.content:
After running multiple tests inhouse as well as open and closed Beta we are now i good position to hammer down the most crucial bugs and issues. We had some great feedback from out 500+ testers and we continue making progress in great strides. We are updating and improving all areas regards, UI, UX, bugs and issues. Thanks all for helping out.

To our newcomers we hope to see you in our DIscord Forum for all the latest news and updates. Beta tests are all conducted through Discord so join us today!

https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/89K6S8rRJm

notes.title: How to receive a copy for FREE
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for testing out our game! We have much work left with an amazing deck building system waiting just around the corner. New vehicles and new maps are beiing worked along new type of weapons, traps and so on. 

We would very much appreciate any feedback we get on the game so everyone who has writen in the discussion forum and helped us improve the game will receive a copy of the game for FREE! This applies to the first 100 participants.

If you want to reach out to us, join us on Discord !

https://discord.gg/89K6S8rRJm
